 Jayant Dabas, Advs.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 22.03.2023 1.
This is an application seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No. 221/2021 dated 14.05.2021 u/s 420/467/468/471/34 IPC registered at PS Swaroop Nagar.
2. The brief facts in the present case are that one Mr. Rajesh Yadav was the owner of land at Khasra No. 1365, Village Kadipur, Gali no.15, Swaroop Nagar.
There is a GPA dated 14.08.2019 allegedly executed by Rajesh Yadav in favour of Nisarrudin and on 23.08.2019, Nisarrudin on the basis of the said GPA, gave the plot of land to the applicant.
The thumb impression of Mr. Rajesh Yadav is alleged to be forged.
Hence the FIR.
3. Mr. Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant states that the applicant is only an attesting witness to the GPA dated 14.08.2019.

He further states that he has no reason to disbelieve the GPA as Mr.
Rajesh Yadav had given similar GPAs for adjoining plots to Nisarrudin and Nisarrudin had sold the plots on the basis of those GPAs.
The same is disputed by Mr. Dabas.
4. When the matter came up for hearing on 06.03.2023, this Court granted interim protection only for the reason that the applicant wanted to settle the matter with Mr. Rajesh Yadav.
However, the same has not been so done from the end of Mr. Rajesh Yadav.

sentences.text: In the present case, the FSL shows that the GPA dated 14.08.2019 is forged.
6. The applicant is an attesting witness to a forged document and also the beneficiary of a plot based on that forged GPA.
7. The investigation is still going on and custodial interrogation of the applicant is required to find out the chain of transaction based on the forged GPA dated 14.08.2019.
8. For the said reasons, I am not inclined to allow the application and the same is dismissed.
JASMEET SINGH, J MARCH 22, 2023/dm
